Each variant is compared with its original's measurement. The originals were chosen because they downgraded often, so some fall in the variants is expected from that selection alone (regression to the mean); a variant that keeps the downgrade is the informative case. Exploratory: hand-authored pairs, one sample each, seven small models, not a study result.
